answer: Mechanism: Chained Echo Census. Each agent registers a random seed and evolves a hash chain at every public beacon epoch, publishing the latest root plus a proof. Probes routed over distinct voyage paths request the root for a randomly selected past epoch, including rare summit and onyx checkpoints. A duplicate reusing the same seed/chain emits colliding roots, triggering an alarm; independent copies must pay full storage/compute per identity. Attack cost: N chains plus probe latency, while any shared state is detectable.
